newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian premier denied access to rebel base.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian premier denied access to rebel base.

text.p: Cambodian co-Premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh was forced on Monday to cancel a trip to this base of Khmer Rouge defectors over fears that rebels loyal to co-Premier Hun Sen would attack him, senior army officers said.

"There is no safety or security here. According to the police and soldiers here there is a threat from the local commander (of Khmer Rogue defectors)," said Lieutenant-General Nhiek Bun Chhay, deputy chief of staff for the armed forces.
Several soldiers in this northwest district of Samlaut called the situation "very, very tense," and villagers said they had been blocked from trying to welcome Ranariddh.
Nhiek Bun Chhay said fears over the prince's safety prompted him to telephone Ranariddh, who was about to board a helicopter at Phnom Penh's Pochentong Airport, and recommended he cancel his flight.
A helicopter carrying several top government ministers from Ranariddh's FUNCINPEC party made the trip, but left after five minutes on the ground, without unloading its passengers.
